references.text: Moses reminds the people of when they sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, which is the same event described in Numbers 13.
God commands the Israelites to go up and take possession of the hill country of the Amorites and the Negev region, corresponding to Moses' instructions to the spies.
Abraham traveled through the Negev region, the same area where Moses sent spies to explore.
Abraham traveled from Egypt to the Negev, the same geographical area that the spies were to explore.
Joshua also sends spies to explore the land, in the same way that Moses sent spies in Numbers 13.
The context of sending out the spies, where Moses received the command to send men to explore Canaan.
The spies explored the land from the Wilderness of Sin to Rehob, including the Negev and Hebron, as Moses instructed them.
The book of Hebrews refers to the generation that came out of Egypt under Moses' leadership and their disobedience, linked to the spy incident.
